status_note: The six targeted projections (S1p0-S1p3 per-space buildHeritageArray with the Stack delay=1 stagger, S2 the live BlockGraph traversal across the RPO relists inside every execute with numhits->Action::count=3, the fold-order-pinning new-MULTIEQUAL creation order and the reciprocal pre->post relinks of all three removeFromFlowSplit calls, S3 the space-preserving RETURN replacement ret_in1==copy_out==unique:0x2000:4 with copy_in0 resolved through the camethruposta side, S4p0/S4p1 the cc:392 heritageyes gate rejecting a no-descendant iblock COPY at heritage pass 0 and admitting it at pass 1) are byte-identical MATCH over 13 records against the locked 12.0.4 oracle with both fixtures executed for real. No residual: every projected branch of the four ported functions is covered bilaterally; the abort paths of the same functions are pinned by CONDEXE-ERROR-0006 (condexe_error_1204) and the pullback legs by CONDEXE-PULLBACK-0005 (condexe_pullback_1204).

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: buildHeritageArray (condexe.cc:23-37) fills the member heritageyes array (cached once per ConditionalExecution construction, cc:436, i.e. once per apply cc:487) and reads fd->numHeritagePasses(spc) — the funcdata.hh:237 inline delegation to Heritage::numHeritagePasses (heritage.cc:2779-2788, returns pass - info->delay, throws only for non-heritaged spaces which cc:33 filters before the call); apply (cc:478-503) mutates only the Funcdata through condexe.execute() and its own protected count (statistics); doReplacement's RETURN leg (cc:339-349) binds the new COPY's output through fd->newVarnodeOut(retvn->getSize(), retvn->getAddr(), newcopyop) — the storage address INCLUDING its address space is the load-bearing preserved output, and the new copy is inserted immediately before the RETURN (cc:345) which then reads it at input[1] (cc:344).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: apply's round loop is do { changethisround=false; for(i=0;i<bblocks.getSize();++i) { bb=(BlockBasic*)bblocks.getBlock(i); if(condexe.trial(bb)) { execute; numhits++; changethisround=true; } } } while(changethisround) with getSize()/getBlock(i) read from the LIVE graph reference (cc:488) on EVERY iteration. Every execute() runs removeFromFlowSplit -> Funcdata::structureReset -> BlockGraph::structureLoops -> findSpanningTree, which REORDERS the blocklist to reverse post-order (block.cc:1135 `list = rpostorder`), so after each fold the cursor walks a re-listed graph: blocks shift under the advancing index and the pre/post fold list orders differ (pinned byte-exactly by the pre and state records). On the S2 chain graph the relist-shifted blocks that fall under the advancing cursor are the three 1-in/1-out postb path blocks (b7/b12/b17), so round 1 itself folds A, B, C (new-MULTIEQUAL creation order b8, b13, b18) — the fold order both implementations must reproduce across the relists and do-while rounds. R17 2(b) correction: the earlier 'an index skip can never strand a TRIALABLE block' reading does NOT generalize — an iblock whose out-edge leads directly to a 2-in/2-out CBRANCH block strands that trialable block for one round; alignment rests on the live-read algorithm, not on any skip-invariance property. buildHeritageArray enumerates i over glb->numSpaces() baselist slots (holes skipped), filtering !isHeritaged before the pass query.
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: numhits is per-apply, incremented once per successful execute (cc:496); changethisround resets at each round start and is set on every hit; count += numhits happens exactly once, AFTER the round loop completes (cc:501) — a throw out of execute or the cc:485-486 unreachable guard skips it (numhits stays uncounted); heritageyes starts all-false per construction and is flipped per space only by numHeritagePasses(spc) > 0 (delay stagger: unique/register/ram at pass 1, stack delay=1 at pass 2); the cc:392 gate consumes the array only for ops whose output has NO descendants (hasnodescend).
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: heritageyes is indexed by spc->getIndex() (baselist slot), independent of the i traversal order; block identification in projections is the creation ordinal (bN) on both sides; the blocklist itself is in reverse post-order after every structureReset (block.cc:1135) and the pre/state records byte-compare those orders; the S2 multi record sorts the three new MULTIEQUALs by their output varnode's allocated unique offset — a monotonically increasing allocator (vbank uniqid, varnode.cc:1265-1272) makes ascending offset == creation order on each side, so the parent-block name sequence is a pointer-free fold-order projection; edge relinks compare FlowBlock pointer identity mapped to Arc::ptr_eq; the RETURN-leg space check compares (space,offset,size) triples, where the space name is part of the key (the old Register-pinned port produced register:0x2000 and fails this projection).

analysis_options.funcdata: Eight synthetic Funcdata objects: S1p0..S1p3 are fresh empty functions whose Heritage infolist is built and whose pass counter is driven to 0/1/2/3 before constructing ConditionalExecution directly (pure buildHeritageArray observation; the fixture stack space carries delay=1 through the SpacebaseSpace ctor dl parameter, translate.hh:181, matching Rugra's enum Stack get_delay()==1); S2 is a 19-block single-entry chain of three diamonds A->B->C whose iblocks sit at consecutive creation indices 3/4/5 — each init computes its own boolean (const inputs 1/2/3 so cross-diamond verifySameCondition fails) and each iblock holds MULTIEQUAL PHI(5,9) whose reader COPY lives in the NEXT merge block (2 in-edges -> getNewMulti), the A/B/C reader merges being b8/b13/b18; S3 is a 6-block diamond whose iblock MULTIEQUAL output (unique:0x2000:4) is read by a RETURN input 1 in the posta block; S4p0/S4p1 are 6-block diamonds whose iblock COPY output has NO descendants (the cc:392 gate input — the non-MULTIEQUAL branch; a no-descendant MULTIEQUAL bypasses the gate) at heritage pass 0/1. S2/S3/S4 run one fd.structureReset() before apply so dominators come from the production path and the pre record proves the cc:485-486 guard does not fire (single entry root).
analysis_options.case_matrix: S1p0..p3: heritage array per space at pass 0/1/2/3; S2: live index walk over the RPO-relisted graph across three folds and do-while rounds (fold order A,B,C pinned by new-MULTIEQUAL creation order; B_init/C_init are trial-shaped but must fail verifySameCondition), numhits=3 -> count, reciprocal pre->post relinks (swap=false straight mapping); S3: RETURN leg preserves unique:0x2000:4 on the COPY output, copy input resolves to the camethruposta-side MULTIEQUAL input const 5, count=1; S4p0: pass 0 -> gate rejects a no-descendant iblock COPY (count=0, diamond intact); S4p1: pass 1 -> gate admits (count=1, iblock gone)
analysis_options.error_injection: none (success channel; aborts are pinned by CONDEXE-ERROR-0006)
analysis_options.normalization: Only two pointer-free projections: block creation ordinals (bN) replace raw pointers, and the S2 multi order sorts the three new MULTIEQUALs by their side-local unique allocation offset (monotonic allocator => creation order) printing parent-block names; absolute unique offsets differ between the sides' allocator bases and are not projected; all other content (space names, offsets of explicitly addressed varnodes, op names, counts, edge endpoints) is byte-compared

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({architecture,compiler_spec,analysis_options,cases}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False)

observation_schema.format: 13 fixed-order pipe-delimited UTF-8 records with final newline
observation_schema.heritage_projection: Per heritage pass count: name=0/1 for the four shared heritaged spaces (ram, register, unique, stack) in that fixed order — the const/join/iop spaces are filtered by cc:33 and the fixture 'other' space is not modeled by Rugra's enumeration (SPACE-0001), so neither appears
observation_schema.state_projection: S2: live-graph per-block op-count inventory (creation-ordinal names, removed iblocks absent), final block count; S4: block count + iblock opcode list with graph-residency probe ('(gone)' after a successful fold — BlockGraph::removeBlock frees the block, so it must not be dereferenced)
observation_schema.counter_projection: apply return code plus the harvested Action::count (C++: CountProbe subclass over the protected member; Rust: take_count_delta, the same channel Action::perform harvests)
observation_schema.multi_projection: The three new getNewMulti MULTIEQUALs' parent blocks sorted by output unique offset (creation order = fold order A,B,C) plus each new multi's input projections (both resolve to const:0x5:4+const:0x9:4 through getMultiequalRead)
observation_schema.edges_projection: Out-neighbor of each prea/preb block after all three removeFromFlowSplit relinks (reciprocal edges: In(0)->Out(0)=posta, In(1)->Out(1)=postb for swap=false)
observation_schema.return_projection: RETURN input-1 triple, the feeding COPY's output triple (space:offset:size — the space is the discriminator the old Register-pinned port failed), the COPY's input-0 triple, the posta op list, final block count
observation_schema.preserved: No space name, offset, size, opcode name, count or edge endpoint is normalized; only raw pointers are replaced by creation ordinals and unique-allocation offsets are used for ordering only

per_space_heritage_array.covers: S1p0..S1p3: buildHeritageArray (condexe.cc:23-37) at heritage pass 0/1/2/3 — ram/register/unique flip true at pass 1, stack stays false until pass 2 (numHeritagePasses = pass - delay with the fixture stack delay=1, heritage.cc:2779-2788), none true at pass 0 (the pass-0 stack value -1 is 'not yet heritaged', i.e. false). Negative control: the pre-fix hardcoded all-true array cannot produce any false slot.

live_traversal_round_partition.covers: S2: apply's for(i=0;i<bblocks.getSize();++i) reads the LIVE graph every iteration (cc:488/492) across the do-while rounds — every execute() triggers removeFromFlowSplit -> structureReset -> findSpanningTree, which relists the blocklist to reverse post-order (block.cc:1135), so the cursor consumes a different list after each of the three folds. The pre record pins the post-pre-reset RPO order (b0,b2,b1,b3,b7,b6,...), the state record the final 16-block order after four resets, the multi record pins the fold sequence A,B,C (creation order of the three new getNewMulti MULTIEQUALs, pointer-free via monotonic unique offsets), and ret pins count=3 with the do-while terminating after the no-hit round. Also pins: ONE ConditionalExecution per apply (single buildHeritageArray), no trial pre-filter (B_init and C_init are trial-shaped 2-in/2-out/CBRANCH blocks that must FAIL inside verifySameCondition, boolB vs boolA / boolC vs boolB uncorrelated), and getNewMulti inserting each new MULTIEQUAL at its merge-block head with inputs resolved to const:0x5+const:0x9 through getMultiequalRead. Structural note (R17 2/5, corrected from the initial header narrative): on THIS graph the blocks the relists shift under the cursor are the three 1-in/1-out postb path blocks (b7/b12/b17), so round 1 folds A,B,C and the fold order is invariant between the live loop and a per-round snapshot — S2 does NOT discriminate live vs snapshot; the byte-equality of the relisted orders and the fold sequence is the observable contract. The invariance claim does not generalize to arbitrary graphs (R17 2(b) counterexample: an iblock out-edge directly into a 2-in/2-out CBRANCH block strands it for a round).

numhits_action_count.covers: S2 count=3, S3 count=1, S4p0 count=0, S4p1 count=1: numhits accumulates per successful execute (cc:496) and lands in Action::count after the round loop (cc:501) — C++ read through the CountProbe subclass over the protected member, Rust through take_count_delta (the channel Action::perform harvests). Negative control: the pre-fix port discarded numhits entirely.

return_space_preservation.covers: S3: doReplacement's RETURN leg (cc:339-349) — the COPY output preserves the RETURN storage address INCLUDING its address space (ret_in1 == copy_out == unique:0x2000:4, cc:343 exact newVarnodeOut leg), the COPY is inserted immediately before the RETURN (posta ops COPY,RETURN), and its input resolves through the camethruposta side to the MULTIEQUAL input const:0x5. Negative control: the pre-fix Register-pinned new_varnode_out prints register:0x2000:4.

heritage_gate_no_descendant.covers: S4p0/S4p1: testRemovability's cc:392 gate — an iblock COPY (non-MULTIEQUAL branch; the cc:368 MULTIEQUAL branch has no heritage check, which the fixture comment records) whose output has NO descendants in the unique space is rejected when the space has had no heritage pass (pass=0: trial false, count=0, diamond fully intact with ib_ops=COPY,CBRANCH and nblocks=6) and admitted at pass=1 (fold proceeds, count=1, iblock gone, nblocks=5). Negative control: the pre-fix all-true heritageyes folds at pass 0 too (count=1 mismatch).

reciprocal_edge_relink.covers: S2 edges record: all three removeFromFlowSplit (swap=false) relinks produce the straight reciprocal mapping In(0)->Out(0)=posta, In(1)->Out(1)=postb (block.cc:1584-1589) — b1->b6, b2->b7, b9->b11, b10->b12, b14->b16, b15->b17 — and the pre record's unreach=0 proves the cc:485-486 guard correctly does NOT fire on the single-entry chain (S4's '(gone)' iblock and the state record's 16-block final graph pin the removal side).
